description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact? 
 At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business. 
 


 Are you ready for your next challenge? 
 Within the Defense Sector, Leidos currently has an opening for a talented Advanced AI-Assisted Software Engineer to work onsite in our Huntsville, AL office in support of the IFPC program, developing software for critical counter-UAS and missile defense solutions. This position focuses on the complete software lifecycle of complex defense systems in a Linux environment using languages such as C++ and Python, developed within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.
  
 What’s in it for you? 
 This is a high-impact, hands-on technical role. You will work alongside the team’s technical lead as a builder of AI-assisted engineering tooling, helping put modern, agentic AI coding practices into practice on the program while also delivering mission software. As a senior engineer, you will work independently on complex problems, lead small features and workstreams, and help mentor other engineers on the team. The ideal candidate has a track record of building professional software with current-generation AI coding assistants and is excited to help adapt those practices to a secure environment where the newest commercial tooling is often restricted.

 THE CHALLENGE (primary responsibilities) 
 Partner closely with the team’s technical lead to translate the team’s AI-assisted development strategy into working tools, workflows, and practices, independently driving assigned efforts from design through delivery.
 Design, build, and maintain AI-assisted development tooling, including custom agents/skills, prompt libraries, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and automated AI code-review and test-generation pipelines – including the more complex, cross-cutting tooling – and review tooling contributions from other engineers.
 Support team adoption of AI coding assistants by pairing with engineers, mentoring  junior engineers, leading enablement sessions, and maintaining team playbooks.
 Stand up and maintain on-prem / self-hosted model environments (e.g., vLLM, Ollama) for secure, restricted, or air-gapped use, resolving complex integration and performance issues, and author the technical documentation that supports the security approval of AI tooling.
 Design and develop production software components in C++ and Python in a Linux environment for counter-UAS and missile defense systems, including the more complex or performance-critical parts of the system.
 Develop within a SAFe environment using Jira and GitLab; apply software best practices such as peer reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD automation – integrating AI responsibly into the software development lifecycle. Serve as a primary code reviewer and help break down features into well-defined work for the team.
 Lead debugging and root-cause analysis of complex software issues in a Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SWIL) setting.
 Help define and refine team engineering, coding, and AI-usage standards, model them in your own work, and produce standardized, reusable, well-documented solutions.
 Collaborate with systems, electrical, test, and cybersecurity engineers to integrate AI tooling and deliver mission software, representing the software team in technical discussions with those groups.
 In this position you will enjoy significant influence on positive outcomes and a strong sense of purpose working directly on fieldable systems that are key to the nation’s defense.
 
 WHAT SETS YOU APART (basic qualifications) 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline and 8+ years of professional software development experience (or Master’s degree + 6 years).
 Recent, substantial, hands-on experience building professional software with current-generation agentic AI coding assistants and AI-assisted development workflows, not just experimentation.
 Strong, current proficiency in C++ and Python.
 Experience across the full software lifecycle, including designing software components, conducting code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD.
 Demonstrated experience mentoring other engineers.
 Experience working within an Agile / SAFe environment and with tools such as Jira and GitLab (or equivalent).
 Experience developing in a Linux environment.
 Currently living in Huntsville, AL or willing to relocate.
 Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Security Clearance (interim and final).
  
 Preferred qualifications 
 Deep, hands-on experience with specific agentic AI coding tools – e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot / Copilot Workspace, Windsurf, Aider.
 Experience building MCP servers, custom agents/skills, prompt/agent libraries, or AI-integrated CI pipelines (e.g., automated code review or test generation) used across a team.
 Experience deploying and operating self-hosted / on-prem large language models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over codebases (e.g., vLLM, Ollama, Amazon Bedrock / GovCloud) in production or disconnected environments.
 Experience adapting modern AI-assisted development workflows to security-constrained, restricted, or disconnected environments.
 Experience leading a feature or small technical workstream.
 Experience working in classified or restricted development environments.
 Python scripting and automation experience for developer tooling and productivity.
 Familiarity with AI governance and safety for software teams: secure use of AI on sensitive code, data-handling, and intellectual-property and security guardrails.
 Commercial / private-sector software experience where access to state-of-the-art agentic AI coding tools is widespread.
 Counter-UAS, missile defense, or other mission-system domain experience.
 Real-time / embedded C++ and experience troubleshooting/testing software in an HWIL environment.
 Experience with Buildroot and VMware; network programming (UDP/TCP) and analysis tools such as Wireshark.
 Experience supporting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
November 23, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $107,900.00 - $195,050.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
